split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before public C API runner, helper, result lifecycle, artifact accessor, status summary, ABI version, public-private partition, generated artifact, or report-only claim
split_policy.positive_rule: frontend C API rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners; public ABI shape and runner summaries are contracts, not behavior support by themselves
split_policy.provenance_rule: runner summaries, emitted artifact paths, diagnostics paths, manifests, IR/object outputs, runtime metadata binaries, header phrases, and source snippets are provenance or contract evidence until a phase owner claims behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: fallback, shim, compatibility, old-mode, report-only, generated-artifact-only, null-invalid-input-as-success, public-private partition bypass, ABI version bypass, borrowed-view lifetime misuse, and stage-summary mismatch claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
